reuse.why: Extends the existing shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend and the weekday-occurrence search with a holidays parameter and a new shared isNonWorkingDay predicate, rather than writing new date logic at the call sites.

duplication.why: The new solveWeekendDate helper removes the two copies in schedule-template, but the same skipWeekend-gated adjustment ternary is still written out in app.ts (twice) and in getNextDate, and every site has to thread config.holidays by hand.

placement.why: The holiday rule sits in shared/schedules.ts next to the weekend logic; only the small solveWeekendDate wrapper is private to the budget module when it belongs with the shared helper.

scope.why: Focused on holidays; the padding constant change is related, though its bump from 3 to 14 is an arbitrary bound.

maintainability.why: A single predicate and a stepwise solver are easy to own; the remaining risk is that a new caller can forget to pass holidays, and the padding of 14 days is a magic number.

disguised_duplication.where: solveWeekendDate in schedule-template.ts mirrors the skipWeekend ternary still inline in app.ts and getNextDate, but it is a straight local extraction rather than a disguised copy.

one_place.where: The non-working-day rule is defined once in isNonWorkingDay (shared/schedules.ts), and getDateWithSkippedWeekend, getNextWeekdayOccurrence, getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange all use it; each call site still has to pass the holidays list explicitly.
